caption: The drawing features a large, rectangular handbag with rounded edges. The main body of the bag displays a tapestry-like pattern with a deep red background and ornate, swirling floral designs in shades of gold, beige, soft green, pink, and blue. Prominently, two blue flowers are situated on the front amidst the gold and beige leaf designs. The bag has two tan-colored handles attached with tan leather straps and gold-colored metal buckles, and there is a metallic gray clasp at the center top. In the lower right corner of the composition, there is a smaller, monochrome outline sketch of the same bag, providing a view of its bottom and showing the handles, straps, and clasp in simple line work without any color or pattern. The background of the drawing is a plain off-white or beige color.
title: Carpet Bag
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
